recursos.tudo: Every tool, including the {ferramentas_plus} Plus only ones
recursos.lote: Batches of up to {limite_lote_plus} files at a time

plus.acao_detalhe: Payment is not automatic yet — see how it works below

modal.titulo: Payment for Plus is not automatic yet
modal.texto: Subscribing to Plus here does not charge anything now. Payment is not integrated yet: arrange it with the administrator outside the site and, once confirmed, they enable your Plus plan manually on your account.

nota_local.texto: No plan changes how the calculation works: everything keeps running in your browser. What Plus unlocks is volume, branding and history — never the result.

pagamento.pergunta: Does clicking "Subscribe to Plus" charge anything?
pagamento.resposta: No. Payment is not integrated into the site yet. The button only explains how to ask for access — nothing is charged here.

liberacao.pergunta: So how do I get Plus?
liberacao.resposta: Arrange the payment with the administrator outside the site. Once confirmed, they enable the Plus plan manually on your account, in /admin.

cancelar.resposta: Talk to the administrator. While payment is not automatic, cancelling is also done manually on your account.

gratis_para_sempre.pergunta: Will the Free plan keep existing?
gratis_para_sempre.resposta: Yes. Most of the tools are free with no usage limit — Plus exists only for people who need bigger volume, their own branding and history.
